_what: How a person's script runs (computer/script-sandbox.mjs). The script runs in a worker thread of its own, inside a vm context whose global has no prototype and holds nothing but `pm` (built in the context from the capabilities the host hands it) and the `libraries` named here. `limits` bound it: `wall_ms` is the longest it may run (finite by default; a run that is still going is terminated, then the thread is stopped), `heap_mb` its memory. A capability is a host object with an allowlist; with none, the script has no files, no cookies and no packages. Every word is here.
